root_bounded_utility.accepted: In this completed h128/depth24 inventory, Ke3 has a positive White result after every legal immediate Black reply. root_bounded_utility.functional_question: Keep an appropriate king posture and the original g-pawn resource until the actual defense/structure permits useful entry or conversion; after a different defense, investigate the task and prices of that new board instead of insisting on one recorded route.
root_bounded_utility.not_equivalent_to: Finding g4 somewhere in each winning PV does not prove g4 is important or uniquely necessary in each of the other six lines. This audit accepts the finite root inventory and its response-specific conversion witnesses, not a universal same-function theorem for every first reply.
root_bounded_utility.quiet_f6_realization: The leading f6 witness uses quiet g4 while White king f4 and original e4 remain. The pawn move transfers the turn without moving that king or e4; the returned ...Ke7 allows Kf5 and the later priced e5/fxe5/Kxe5 trade. ...f5 remains a legal Black alternative at that later point, so only a bounded witnessed realization is claimed there.
root_bounded_utility.Ke6_realization: The nearly equal Ke6 witness is a queenside preparation/exchange route with White Kd2, original c3 loss, original a3 advanced to b6 and original b2 relocated to a3. obsolete_or_overbroad_conditions_rejecte: Require g4 to be a check: all eight new original-root PVs use g4 quietly.
Require e4 already to have disappeared before g4: original e4 is still present at g4 in seven of eight new PVs, including both leading defenses.
Require all original White pawns to survive: multiple branches contain actual original a3/c3/e4 losses.
Require a promoted queen to survive: the f5 line actually loses the promoted original e4 queen to ...Kxd7.
Require the same f4/f5 approach in every Black-first-defense branch: the Ke6 route uses the queenside and never visits either square.
Require the exact book ...b3 structure after ...bxc3: original c3 is gone and original b2 occupies c3 in the latter.
